title: Episode 46
logline: The High Priest places the sanctuary under Crown seizure and invalidates Alexander and Juliana's wedding for lack of royal license, prompting Alexander to demand a ten-day ecclesiastical trial while Catherine schemes to destroy them.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 45's cliffhanger where the High Priest stormed into the church with royal guards and challenged the legality of Alexander and Juliana's marriage.

Start: (00:11.00) | End: (00:13.80)
Medium shot of the High Priest holding up a wax-sealed document before his chest, flanked by two armed guards.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:11.00) | End: (00:13.80)
Medium shot of the High Priest holding up a wax-sealed document before his chest, flanked by two armed guards.

blocks.speaker: HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Authoritative):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:11.50) | End: (00:16.80)
"By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown scesion."

Start: (00:13.80) | End: (00:17.20)
Close-up of the High Priest's fingers breaking the crimson wax seal and string on the war office envelope.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:13.80) | End: (00:17.20)
Close-up of the High Priest's fingers breaking the crimson wax seal and string on the war office envelope.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:15.00) | End: (00:16.80)
Crisp tear of wax and parchment string snapping open.
blocks.action:
Start: (00:15.00) | End: (00:16.80)
Crisp tear of wax and parchment string snapping open.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:17.20) | End: (00:20.50)
Low-angle medium shot of the High Priest opening the yellowed War Office document.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:17.20) | End: (00:20.50)
Low-angle medium shot of the High Priest opening the yellowed War Office document.

blocks.speaker: HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Commanding):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:17.30) | End: (00:20.40)
"None shall leave until every witness is accounted for."

Start: (00:20.50) | End: (00:22.80)
Wide shot of Alexander and Juliana standing defiant at the altar as congregation members watch in silence.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:20.50) | End: (00:22.80)
Wide shot of Alexander and Juliana standing defiant at the altar as congregation members watch in silence.

blocks.speaker: HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Cold, Accusatory):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:20.60) | End: (00:22.80)
"You married this woman as a nameless beggar..."

Start: (00:22.80) | End: (00:26.80)
Medium close-up of the High Priest holding the decree, his gaze burning with disdain.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:22.80) | End: (00:26.80)
Medium close-up of the High Priest holding the decree, his gaze burning with disdain.

blocks.speaker: HIGH PRIEST (Scornful, Harsh):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:22.90) | End: (00:26.50)
"...in a hedge ceremony no clerk in England ever recorded."

Start: (00:26.80) | End: (00:30.50)
Full shot of the High Priest brandishing the letter aloft in the center of the chapel nave.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:26.80) | End: (00:30.50)
Full shot of the High Priest brandishing the letter aloft in the center of the chapel nave.

blocks.speaker: HIGH PRIEST (Resonant, Dismissive):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:26.80) | End: (00:31.80)
"Three years later, the beggar is revealed to be a Duke. The marriage does not rise with him."

Start: (00:30.50) | End: (00:34.20)
Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana, placing a protective hand on her arm.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:30.50) | End: (00:34.20)
Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana, placing a protective hand on her arm.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:32.50) | End: (00:34.50)
Juliana places her hand over Alexander's as he steps forward to shield her.
blocks.action:
Start: (00:32.50) | End: (00:34.50)
Juliana places her hand over Alexander's as he steps forward to shield her.

blocks.text:
Start: (00:34.20) | End: (00:37.00)
Close-up of Alexander, his scarred face hardening with unwavering conviction.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:34.20) | End: (00:37.00)
Close-up of Alexander, his scarred face hardening with unwavering conviction.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER (Gravely, Firm):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:34.30) | End: (00:36.70)
"She married the man... not the title."

Start: (00:37.00) | End: (00:42.80)
Low-angle shot looking up at the High Priest as he raises the parchment toward the vaulted ceiling.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:37.00) | End: (00:42.80)
Low-angle shot looking up at the High Priest as he raises the parchment toward the vaulted ceiling.

blocks.speaker: HIGH PRIEST (Harsh, Derisive):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:37.30) | End: (00:42.50)
"The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone."

Start: (00:42.80) | End: (00:47.00)
Medium shot of the High Priest lowering the document, raising a single finger in admonishment.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:42.80) | End: (00:47.00)
Medium shot of the High Priest lowering the document, raising a single finger in admonishment.

blocks.speaker: HIGH PRIEST (Rigid, Formal):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:42.80) | End: (00:47.00)
"No Crown license was sought, because no one thought to ask leave for a Duke to marry."

Start: (00:47.00) | End: (00:49.00)
Two-shot of Juliana and Alexander listening intently, Juliana's eyes flashing with hurt and defiance.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:47.00) | End: (00:49.00)
Two-shot of Juliana and Alexander listening intently, Juliana's eyes flashing with hurt and defiance.

blocks.speaker: HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Sharp):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:47.10) | End: (00:49.00)
"No licensed clergyman presided..."

Start: (00:49.00) | End: (00:52.20)
Close-up of the High Priest glaring intently.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:49.00) | End: (00:52.20)
Close-up of the High Priest glaring intently.

blocks.speaker: HIGH PRIEST (Scathing):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:49.00) | End: (00:52.20)
"...because a frightened village priest has no authority to bind a peer."

Start: (00:52.20) | End: (00:58.20)
Medium shot pushing into a close-up as the High Priest thrusts the royal War Office proclamation directly into the camera.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:52.20) | End: (00:58.20)
Medium shot pushing into a close-up as the High Priest thrusts the royal War Office proclamation directly into the camera.

blocks.speaker: HIGH PRIEST (Thundering):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:52.20) | End: (00:58.00)
"And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead."

Start: (00:58.20) | End: (01:02.80)
Close-up of Juliana lifting her chin, tearful yet burning with righteous fury.
blocks.camera:
Start: (00:58.20) | End: (01:02.80)
Close-up of Juliana lifting her chin, tearful yet burning with righteous fury.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Fierce, Defiant):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:58.50) | End: (01:02.50)
"I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father."

Start: (01:02.80) | End: (01:05.80)
Medium two-shot of Juliana standing proudly beside Alexander.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:02.80) | End: (01:05.80)
Medium two-shot of Juliana standing proudly beside Alexander.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Passionate, Resolute):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:02.90) | End: (01:05.50)
"I won't ask it for permission to love."

Start: (01:05.80) | End: (01:11.00)
Close-up of the High Priest looking down, a sinister, condescending smirk gracing his lips.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:05.80) | End: (01:11.00)
Close-up of the High Priest looking down, a sinister, condescending smirk gracing his lips.

blocks.speaker: HIGH PRIEST (Condescending, Venomous):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:06.80) | End: (01:10.50)
"Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does."

Start: (01:11.00) | End: (01:16.80)
Slow push-in medium close-up on Juliana, her voice trembling with intense indignation.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:11.00) | End: (01:16.80)
Slow push-in medium close-up on Juliana, her voice trembling with intense indignation.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Accusatory, Pained):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:11.40) | End: (01:14.30)
"Then look at this floor honestly, for once."

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Voice Breaking, Passionate):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:14.40) | End: (01:16.60)
"A church called me unworthy."

Start: (01:16.80) | End: (01:18.00)
Quick cut to the High Priest maintaining a smug, impenetrable stare.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:16.80) | End: (01:18.00)
Quick cut to the High Priest maintaining a smug, impenetrable stare.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (O.S.) (Bitter):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:16.80) | End: (01:18.00)
"A church chained me."

Start: (01:18.00) | End: (01:25.80)
Extreme close-up on Juliana's face as she shouts at the priest.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:18.00) | End: (01:25.80)
Extreme close-up on Juliana's face as she shouts at the priest.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Furious, Resolute):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:18.10) | End: (01:21.00)
"Now a church calls my marriage a lie!"

blocks.speaker: JULIANA (Shouting, Triumphant):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:21.10) | End: (01:25.50)
"God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!"

Start: (01:25.80) | End: (01:29.20)
Medium close-up of Catherine leaning against a stone archway, whispering with venomous mockery.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:25.80) | End: (01:29.20)
Medium close-up of Catherine leaning against a stone archway, whispering with venomous mockery.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Malicious, Taunting):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:26.10) | End: (01:29.00)
"Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you."

Start: (01:29.20) | End: (01:32.50)
Close-up of the High Priest pressing the document against his chest, his eyes darkening with anger.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:29.20) | End: (01:32.50)
Close-up of the High Priest pressing the document against his chest, his eyes darkening with anger.

blocks.speaker: HIGH PRIEST (O.S. / Low, Threatening):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:29.30) | End: (01:32.40)
"Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness."

Start: (01:32.50) | End: (01:36.00)
Low-angle shot of the High Priest stepping up the altar steps toward them.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:32.50) | End: (01:36.00)
Low-angle shot of the High Priest stepping up the altar steps toward them.

blocks.speaker: HIGH PRIEST (Commanding, Severe):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:32.20) | End: (01:36.20)
"God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!"

Start: (01:36.00) | End: (01:36.80)
Brief insert of Catherine smirking as she watches from the side.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:36.00) | End: (01:36.80)
Brief insert of Catherine smirking as she watches from the side.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:36.80) | End: (01:40.50)
Wide shot of the High Priest waving the letter overhead before the congregation.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:36.80) | End: (01:40.50)
Wide shot of the High Priest waving the letter overhead before the congregation.

blocks.speaker: HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Threatening):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:36.80) | End: (01:40.40)
"And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!"

Start: (01:40.50) | End: (01:41.80)
Close-up of Catherine listening eagerly.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:40.50) | End: (01:41.80)
Close-up of Catherine listening eagerly.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:41.80) | End: (01:46.80)
Profile medium shot of Alexander confronting the High Priest face-to-face at the foot of the altar.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:41.80) | End: (01:46.80)
Profile medium shot of Alexander confronting the High Priest face-to-face at the foot of the altar.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER (Cold, Resolute):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:41.80) | End: (01:46.50)
"A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal."

Start: (01:46.80) | End: (01:51.80)
Low-angle two-shot of the High Priest staring up into Alexander's imposing frame.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:46.80) | End: (01:51.80)
Low-angle two-shot of the High Priest staring up into Alexander's imposing frame.

blocks.speaker: HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Unflinching):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:47.00) | End: (01:51.50)
"The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours."

Start: (01:51.80) | End: (01:58.50)
Medium close-up of Alexander glaring with icy authority.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:51.80) | End: (01:58.50)
Medium close-up of Alexander glaring with icy authority.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER (Defiant, Commanding):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:52.00) | End: (01:58.20)
"Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel."

Start: (01:58.50) | End: (02:04.00)
Wide profile two-shot of the High Priest and Alexander locked in an intense standoff before the altar.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:58.50) | End: (02:04.00)
Wide profile two-shot of the High Priest and Alexander locked in an intense standoff before the altar.

blocks.speaker: HIGH PRIEST (Chilling, Victorious):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:58.80) | End: (02:03.60)
"Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice."

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER (Steely, Unfazed):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:04.00) | End: (02:06.50)
"I'll take that wager over your decree."

Start: (02:06.50) | End: (02:07.20)
Quick reaction shot of the elderly woman in the pew gripping her beads in distress.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:06.50) | End: (02:07.20)
Quick reaction shot of the elderly woman in the pew gripping her beads in distress.

blocks.text:
Start: (02:07.20) | End: (02:13.50)
Wide shot from behind the guards as they surround Alexander and Juliana, halberds and swords pointed inches from Alexander's chest.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:07.20) | End: (02:13.50)
Wide shot from behind the guards as they surround Alexander and Juliana, halberds and swords pointed inches from Alexander's chest.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER (Thunderous, Imposing):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:07.20) | End: (02:13.20)
"Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!"

Start: (02:13.50) | End: (02:18.80)
Medium shot of the High Priest extending his hand toward the guards, commanding them to stand down.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:13.50) | End: (02:18.80)
Medium shot of the High Priest extending his hand toward the guards, commanding them to stand down.

blocks.text:
Start: (02:14.00) | End: (02:16.00)
The guards slowly lower their weapon points away from the Duke.
blocks.action:
Start: (02:14.00) | End: (02:16.00)
The guards slowly lower their weapon points away from the Duke.

blocks.speaker: HIGH PRIEST (Ominous, Warning):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:14.20) | End: (02:18.50)
"Ten days, Duke. Choose your witnesses well."

Start: (02:18.80) | End: (02:20.50)
The High Priest turns sharply on his heel and strides past the guards toward the church exit.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:18.80) | End: (02:20.50)
The High Priest turns sharply on his heel and strides past the guards toward the church exit.

blocks.text:
Start: (02:19.00) | End: (02:22.00)
Shuffling boots and clattering armor as the royal guards turn and retreat down the ruined aisle.
blocks.action:
Start: (02:19.00) | End: (02:22.00)
Shuffling boots and clattering armor as the royal guards turn and retreat down the ruined aisle.

blocks.text:
Start: (02:20.50) | End: (02:23.88)
Slow pan to Catherine standing in her bridal gown beside the sunlit aisle, watching the priest depart before turning to camera with a wicked, predatory smile.
blocks.camera:
Start: (02:20.50) | End: (02:23.88)
Slow pan to Catherine standing in her bridal gown beside the sunlit aisle, watching the priest depart before turning to camera with a wicked, predatory smile.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE (Whispering, Malicious):
blocks.text:
Start: (02:21.20) | End: (02:23.80)
"Ten days is plenty of time."
